conditions.aligned_real: sender pooled capture -> frozen affine transform -> 8-slot injection, rescaled to natural median
conditions.random: per-item seeded gaussian, norm-matched to the effective aligned_real vector, real path
conditions.zerovec_injected: TRUE ZERO VECTOR through the real 8-slot injection path (scale: None — rescale undefined at norm 0); closes ADR-023 A7(c): distinct from S0 G5's empty-position branch and from S1a's uninjected 'zero'

config.natural_norm_source: receiver forward_capture over the slotted injection prompt at the inject block, per item (S0 cross-model precedent, s0-receipt.json config.injection_vector)
config.primary_test: one-sided exact sign test, paired accuracy, aligned_real > random, alpha 0.05 (A7(b))
config.secondary_diagnostic: one-sided sign tests on paired teacher-forced NLL of '#### <gold>'

transform.apply: hand-rolled affine y = mu_r + alpha*(z - mu_s)*R (latentmesh-align cannot be a path dep: align -> latentmesh-core pins half =2.4.1 vs candle's half ^2.5)

hand_rolled_apply_verification.note: golden outputs produced by latentmesh-align::AlignmentTransform::apply on the same artifact; asserted before any model ran

config.zerovec_gate: pre-committed: pass iff 2 x zerovec accuracy >= baseline accuracy ('not catastrophically below baseline'); numbers reported either way (A7(c))

contingency: ADR-023 Deviation 7: pre-registered generated-pairs recalibration re-probe; transform fitted on sender-GENERATED reasoning pairs (S2c), protocol knobs frozen (same 40 items, same sign test, same alpha, same slots/pooling/rescale/decoding)
design: docs/adr/023-live-four-condition-run1-pre-registration.md (A7 coordinator resolution, Deviation 6); protocol = S1a's frozen protocol (docs/research/024 section 7 S1a) with the S2-fitted cross-model transform
